name: Potato Gnocchi with Homemade Creamy Tomato Sauce (Rosé)

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
Once the water in the pot is boiling, add gnocchi and salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until gnocchi begins to float to the surface, about 3 minutes. Drain in a colander and return to the pot.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 (454 g) pkg potato gnocchi
1 tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion.
Once the pan is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp butter, unsalted
1 tsp Italian seasoning
½ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add tomato sauce and cream to the pan, then stir to combine the rosé sauce. Bring to a simmer, then reduce heat to medium-low; continue to cook until sauce is thickened slightly, 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
213 ml tomato sauce
¾ cup heavy whipping cream

instructions.primary_message: Add rosé sauce and cheese to the pot with the gnocchi. Return to medium heat and cook, stirring constantly, until cheese is melted and gnocchi is coated in sauce, about 1 minute. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide gnocchi and sauce between plates or bowls, sprinkle with additional cheese, and enjoy!
